judge.rationale: The candidate stopped after writing a `.lore/dod.md` planning file and an initial failing acceptance test file (`src/transport/conversationList.acceptance.test.ts`). No production code, types, validation logic, message handler logic, configuration options, specs, or documentation were modified or added. Because the feature was not implemented at all, the new acceptance tests will fail and none of the issue's acceptance criteria are met. In addition, the candidate's first two test assertions overlook that connecting creates a fresh session for `u1` with a current timestamp, which would affect the expected conversation list if the timestamps aren't set ahead of the test runtime.
